# Fictio Consulting

> Practical AI fluency for small businesses and educators. Fictio Consulting builds hands-on AI skills that fit the way people actually work, starting with the tools people already have. Based in Eastern Ontario, serving clients across Canada.

Fictio Consulting works with both individuals and teams. Some clients are a single educator or business owner building their own skills before rolling anything out to a team; others are a department or staff group ready to train together. Work is remote by default, with clients anywhere in Canada. On-site sessions are available in Eastern Ontario where there is a room where everyone can work at a computer together.

The supported platforms are Microsoft 365 Copilot (including Copilot Chat) and Anthropic Claude.

The first step is a free 20-minute conversation on Microsoft Teams, with no preparation needed and no obligation.

## Services

- [Needs Assessment](https://fictioconsulting.ca/#needs-assessment): Most clients start here. A paid service with one fixed price. It starts with a one-hour conversation with you, or with you and your team, about how your work moves. Within a week you receive a written AI Opportunity Brief showing where AI may fit, workflow by workflow, and where the honest answer is a process change rather than AI. What you share stays confidential.
- [AI Literacy Training](https://fictioconsulting.ca/#services): Half-day or full-day hands-on workshops built around your team's real work, starting with the AI tools you already have. Online anywhere in Canada, or on-site in Eastern Ontario.
- [AI Platform Onboarding](https://fictioconsulting.ca/#services): For a team that has chosen Microsoft 365 Copilot or Claude. A review of licences and use cases, two or three sessions on your real work, and a written adoption guide.
- [Learning Loop](https://fictioconsulting.ca/#services): Learn, apply, share and refine, with your own internal champion keeping practice going between sessions.
- [Responsible AI Use](https://fictioconsulting.ca/#services): Plain-language guardrails: an AI use policy covering approved tools, what information can go into which tool, checking AI output, disclosure, and AI-specific scams. Practical guidance, not legal advice.
- [Ongoing AI Advisory](https://fictioconsulting.ca/#services): A monthly session, answers between sessions, a look at new tools as they appear, and a quarterly check-in.

## About

- [About Fictio Consulting](https://fictioconsulting.ca/#about): Founded by Patrick Hymus. Master of Education; Anthropic Academy and Microsoft Learn AI certifications; more than twenty years teaching adults; insured for technology E&O and general liability.
- [FAQ](https://fictioconsulting.ca/#faq): Common questions, including where to start, working with individuals or teams, and on-site or remote work.
